positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Integrated sentry-native on Windows and sentry-cocoa on macOS to enable automatic error tracking and monitoring.
- Evaluated build systems and project dependencies to identify and implement strategies for improving build performance and dependency management.
- Re-engineered the palette system to enable users to dock and undock palettes, as well as group them within a tab control for improved usability and flexibility.
- Participated in creating a new UI control that provides a set of on-demand menus that are context sensitive next to the mouse cursor on the drawing view.
- Re-engineered and added widget groups in a UI control that is used to modify the models, making it run faster and smoother, as well as allowing users to spend more time on the more important information and less time scrolling.
- Participated in converting Vectorworks to a Unicode-compliant system where texts are based on UTF-16 encoding, regardless of the operating system setting.
- Created an internal system that filters out Perforce changelists based on given branch, tag, start and end dates.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
-    Participated in test-driven development process and helped to fix Marionette bugs.
-    Contributed to the final documentation of the Marionette default library content.
-    Enhanced the documentation to help end users achieve success with Marionette scripting.
-    Integrated different Python libraries to Marionette.
-    Participated in the production and delivery of a new feature called Marionette.
-    Provided supports for an Oculus Rift project prototype.
-    Improved the search functionality of the Vectorworks developer website using Google Custom Search Engine.

positions.title: Math Tutor
positions.description:
-    Assisted students in mastering different concepts in mathematics, physics, and chemistry.
-    Collaborated with approximately 100 students a week individually or in small groups.
-    Received a certificate of appreciation award by NVCC Tutoring Center.
